# Essential Duas for Students (Must Remember)

*We, the students of Imam Jafar as-Sadiq (a.s.), let us learn and grow together and make ourselves true students of the Holy Prophet (S) and his purified Ahlulbayt (a.s.).*

---

### 1. Dua Before Class
**Spiritual Objective:** To dispel confusion, lift the darkness of doubt, and open the faculties of comprehension before attending lectures or instruction.

> **Arabic:**  
> اَللّٰهُمَّ اَخْرِجْنِيْ مِنْ ظُلُمَاتِ الْوَهْمِ وَ اَكْرِمْنِيْ بِنُوْرِ الْفَهْمِ  
> 
> **Transliteration:**  
> *Allhumma Akhrijni min zulumatil wahmi wa akrimni bi-nuril fahmi*  
> 
> **Translation:**  
> "O God, bring me out of the darkness of doubt and favor me with the light of understanding."

> **Arabic:**  
> اَللّٰهُمَّ افْتَحْ عَلَيْنَا اَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ وَ انْشُرْ عَلَيْنَا خَزَآئِنَ عُلُوْمِكَ بِرَحْمَتِكَ يَا اَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِيْنَ  
> 
> **Transliteration:**  
> *Allahumma aftah alayna abwaba rahmatika wa anshur alayna khaza'ina uloomika bi-rahmatika ya arhamar raahimeen*  
> 
> **Translation:**  
> "O God, open to us the doors of Your mercy and unfold for us the treasures of Your knowledge, by Your mercy, O Most Merciful of the merciful."

---

### 2. Dua Before Studying
**Spiritual Objective:** Seeking knowledge that truly benefits, with prophetic clarity of mind and heartfelt reverence.

> **Arabic:**  
> اللَّهُمَّ انْفَعْنِي بِمَا عَلَّمْتَنِي وَ عَلِّمْنِي مَا يَنْفَعُنِي  
> 
> **Transliteration:**  
> *Allahumma infa'ni bima allamtani wa allimni ma yanfa'uni*  
> 
> **Translation:**  
> "O Allah, benefit me through what You have taught me and teach me what will benefit me."

> **Arabic:**  
> اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ فَهْمَ النَّبِيِّينَ وَ حِفْظَ الْمُرْسَلِينَ الْمُقَرَّبِينَ  
> 
> **Transliteration:**  
> *Allahumma inni as'aluka fahmal nabiyyin wa hifzal mursaleen al-muqarrabeen*  
> 
> **Translation:**  
> "O Allah, grant me the understanding of the prophets and the memory of the close messengers."

> **Arabic:**  
> اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ لِسَانِي عَامِرًا بِذِكْرِكَ وَ قَلْبِي بِخَشْيَتِك  
> 
> **Transliteration:**  
> *Allahumma ij'al lisani amiran bi-dhikrika wa qalbi bi-khashyatik*  
> 
> **Translation:**  
> "O Allah, make my tongue flourishing with Your remembrance and my heart filled with awe of You."

---

### 3. Dua for Removing Anxiety & Procrastination
**Spiritual Objective:** Overcoming exam stress, mental fatigue, helplessness, and indolence.

> **Arabic:**  
> اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَ الْحَزَنِ وَ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْعَجْزِ وَ الْكَسَلِ  
> 
> **Transliteration:**  
> *Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min al-hammi wal-hazan wa a'udhu bika min al-ajzi wal-kasal*  
> 
> **Translation:**  
> "O Allah, I seek refuge in You from worry and grief, helplessness and laziness."

---

### 4. Dua While Studying Something Difficult
**Spiritual Objective:** Removing intellectual hurdles and easing difficult concepts.

> **Arabic:**  
> اللَّهُمَّ لاَ سَهْلًا إِلَّا مَا جَعَلْتَهُ سَهْلًا وَ أَنْتَ تَجْعَلُ الْحَزْنَ إِذَا شِئْتَ سَهْلًا  
> 
> **Transliteration:**  
> *Allahumma la sahla illa ma ja'altahu sahlan wa anta taj'alul hazna idha shi'ta sahlan*  
> 
> **Translation:**  
> "O Allah, nothing is easy except what You make easy, and You make hardship easy when You will."

---

### 5. Dua After Studying & Review
**Spiritual Objective:** Entrusting acquired knowledge to the Divine Protector for retention and recall during exams.

> **Arabic:**  
> اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْتَوْدِعُكَ مَا قَرَأْتُ وَمَا حَفِظْتُ فَرُدَّهُ عَلَيَّ عِنْدَ حَاجَتِي إِلَيْهِ  
> 
> **Transliteration:**  
> *Allahumma inni astaudi'uka ma qara'tu wa ma hafiztu fa-ruddahu alayya inda hajati ilayh*  
> 
> **Translation:**  
> "O Allah, I entrust You with what I have read and memorized, so return it to me when I am in need of it."
